annotations.target_phrase: We have grown out of Wilde and paradoxes
annotations.annotation_text: Oscar Wilde, The Picture of Dorian Gray, Chapter Two: "The few words that Basil's friend [Lord Henry Wotton] had said to him—words spoken by chance, no doubt, and with wilful paradox in them...."
sources: Gifford, Don, and Robert J. Seidman. Ulysses Annotated. University of California Press, 1988.
